title: Exclusive: Bewakoof Cofounder Prabhkiran Singh Launches AI Shopping Assistant Save8
summary: Bewakoof cofounder and former CEO Prabhkiran Singh has launched Save8, an AI-powered shopping assistant that helps consumers compare prices and…
llm_summary: Prabhkiran Singh, co‑founder and former CEO of fashion brand Bewakoof, has unveiled Save8—a conversational AI shopping assistant that scans multiple e‑commerce sites in real time to surface the best prices, discounts and alternatives for any product.
